question: In Melanoma trials, bucket overall follow-up months into <12, 12–23, or ≥24.

steps.desc: Filter Melanoma trials and select follow-up duration.

steps.prompt: For each row, read follow_up_months and output JSON {NCT, PMID, follow_up_months_clean}. If follow_up_months is null or blank, set follow_up_months_clean to -1. Otherwise, set follow_up_months_clean equal to follow_up_months. JSON only.

steps.desc: Bucket the follow-up duration into <12, 12–23, or ≥24.
steps.sql:
WITH duration_buckets AS (
  SELECT
    t1.*,
    CASE
      WHEN CAST(t2.follow_up_months_clean AS DOUBLE PRECISION) < 0 THEN 'missing'
      WHEN CAST(t2.follow_up_months_clean AS DOUBLE PRECISION) < 12 THEN '<12'
      WHEN CAST(t2.follow_up_months_clean AS DOUBLE PRECISION) BETWEEN 12 AND 23 THEN '12-23'
      WHEN CAST(t2.follow_up_months_clean AS DOUBLE PRECISION) >= 24 THEN '>=24'
      ELSE 'unknown'
    END AS follow_up_bucket
  FROM t1 JOIN t2 ON t1."NCT" = t2."NCT"
)
SELECT "NCT", "PMID", "Author", "Year", follow_up_bucket FROM duration_buckets
